# Cyril Lisle

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Origin:** Portmaris  <sub>[v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>
- **Role:** Student  <sub>[v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P39](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0039), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047)</sub>

## Appearance

Cyril is an attractive young man with endearing good looks, magnificent dreamy dark eyes, and a deep, velvety smile. He wears a fragment of the Wexcombe scarlet and white colors on his coat lapel.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c36 P24](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0024)_

## Personality

Cyril is polite, respectful, and romantic, possessing an appealing voice and a habit of expressing poetic praise. However, he is somber and mysterious, lacking a sense of humor to the point of missing the punchline of amusing stories. Despite his striking looks, wealth, and intelligence, those close to him—including his sister Dorothy—feel he lacks real substance and interest once known well.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c38 P14](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0014), [v3 c38 P44](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0044), [v3 c39 P2](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0002)_

- Poetry writing  <sub>[v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036)</sub>

## History

Cyril belonged to an elite family in Portmaris. Two years prior to returning to Wexcombe, he was forced to pause his university education to travel overseas alongside his mother when her health broke down. Upon resuming his studies in his Junior year at Wexcombe, he began pursuing Nell Harcourt, showering her with violets, romantic praise, and original sonnets. While most residents of Tabby's Place admired his polite manners, he was disliked by the Sarah-cat, whom he bothered. He grew highly confident that Nell would accept his courtship and marry him, but she ultimately turned him down, realizing she did not truly love him.

_Sources: [v3 c25 P35](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0035), [v3 c25 P47](../source/v03-c25.md#nw-v03-c25-p0047), [v3 c26 P18](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0018), [v3 c27 P36](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0036), [v3 c37 P31](../source/v03-c37.md#nw-v03-c37-p0031), [v3 c38 P19](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0019), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044)_
